option_relations.rationale: Bacterial myositis is a broader category that includes pyomyositis and intramuscular abscesses caused by bacteria, such as the one described in the leaf.
Deep neck space infection is a broader category that encompasses infections in various deep neck spaces, including intramuscular abscesses in the neck muscles like the levator scapulae.

Pyomyositis of the levator scapulae muscle caused by Fusobacterium necrophorum is clinically equivalent to a deep neck infection with a left levator scapulae muscle abscess due to F. necrophorum infection, as pyomyositis is an intramuscular abscess.
Cervical intramuscular abscess (levator scapulae) due to F. necrophorum is clinically equivalent to a deep neck infection with a left levator scapulae muscle abscess due to F. necrophorum infection.
